crossRefs.note: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there…
When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people…
For the palace will be forsaken. The populous city will be deserted. The hill and the watchtower will be for dens…

translations.web: The peaceful folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Yahweh.
translations.bsb: The peaceful meadows have been silenced because of the LORD’s burning anger.
translations.kjv: And the peaceable habitations are cut down because of the fierce anger of the LORD.
translations.asv: And the peaceable folds are brought to silence because of the fierce anger of Jehovah.
